Limitations: check_run recomputes IoU from the saved pred and gt masks but does not check the saved gt against the mask files on disk, so a coordinated edit of gt, iou and the headline would pass; I verified the real gt matches the files myself. started_at and finished_at in the record are identical (13:51:21.438366), so run timing is not recorded there (per-epoch seconds are in attempts).
